notes.text: Claim that StringBuilderPooledObjectPolicy.Return calls Clear() and returns false (does not keep the instance) when Capacity exceeds MaximumRetainedCapacity is from memory of the Microsoft.Extensions.ObjectPool source; please confirm against the source or the ObjectPool docs page.
StringBuilder.Clear is described as equivalent to setting Length to 0 and keeping the allocated buffer (capacity unchanged); verify the docs wording on the Clear page.

Expected runtime output of the buggy snippet is 'alice: 3 unread' then 'alice: 3 unreadbob: 5 unread' (traced by hand, not executed). The fixed snippet output is 'alice: 3 unread\nbob: 5 unread'. Run run-snippets to confirm.

Only line 12 (pool.Push without Clear) is accepted. A reviewer may want to also accept line 7 (Rent could clear before handing out); the explanation argues reset-on-return is the convention, following StringBuilderPooledObjectPolicy.
